validation_protocols.name: HuanYu wayfinding false-alert protocol
validation_protocols.test_object: 固定的匿名场景标签+导视提示逻辑；不测试真实个体识别。
validation_protocols.sample_window: 拟在两处概念节点各选 3 个时段（工作日早/晚、周末日间），每时段至少 30 条人工复核事件；正式样本量待基线建立。
validation_protocols.unit: 每条提示事件；误报率=人工判定为不需要提示但系统发出提示的事件数/全部提示事件数；响应时延为秒。
validation_protocols.baseline: TBD：现场踏勘后由交通/无障碍专业人员建立纸面提示基线；当前无实测基线。
validation_protocols.threshold: TBD：误报率上限、P95 响应时延和漏报上限在基线与安全评审后确定；不得以当前概念值宣称达标。
validation_protocols.error_stratification: 按节点、时段、天气/光照、步行/骑行方式、无障碍需求和提示类型分组；组内样本不足时只报告样本量，不下结论。
validation_protocols.human_reviewer: 运营方现场复核员+交通安全/无障碍专业顾问各 1 名；争议事件由人工双签。
validation_protocols.failure_handling: 暂停该提示类型，改用静态标识、人工岗和纸面导览；记录误报/漏报，重新标注后再拟验证。
validation_protocols.stop_conditions: 发生安全事件、无法人工接管、任一关键分组出现不可解释漏报，或数据完整性低于预设审计门槛时停止。

validation_protocols.name: Wheel-Trace dock scheduling load protocol
validation_protocols.test_object: 跨驿站借还调度的离线回放/沙盒规则，不接入真实账户。
validation_protocols.sample_window: 拟采用 3 个概念时段（平日峰、平日平段、活动模拟），每时段由已脱敏的合成需求序列回放；真实需求样本 TBD。
validation_protocols.unit: 每次请求、每站点每 15 分钟聚合窗口；记录可用车位差、响应秒数、失败请求比例。
validation_protocols.baseline: TBD：由人工纸面调度与现场踏勘建立对照；当前没有历史借还基线。
validation_protocols.threshold: TBD：在安全与维护评审后确定最大允许失败请求比例、P95 响应时延和站点公平性阈值；不得写成服务等级已达成。
validation_protocols.error_stratification: 按时段、节点、请求方向、步行/骑行替代需求、无障碍车辆需求和数据缺失类型分群。
validation_protocols.human_reviewer: 运营调度负责人+社区代表+数据质量复核员；异常窗口由人工复盘。
validation_protocols.failure_handling: 回退到现场人工登记、纸面排队和固定安全余量；删除异常回放，不自动扩容或改变空间。
validation_protocols.stop_conditions: 连续两个窗口无法解释的失败、无障碍需求被系统性挤出、或人工无法在窗口内接管时停止。

validation_protocols.name: Anonymous cycling-flow dashboard quality protocol
validation_protocols.test_object: 匿名聚合流量计数与公开看板的分组、去重和缺测处理流程。
validation_protocols.sample_window: 拟在 3 个节点各选择工作日/周末、早晚/日间共 6 个窗口；当前没有现场计数，样本与时段须现场核定。
validation_protocols.unit: 15 分钟聚合计数、缺测率%、重复计数率%、人工抽样一致率%；只发布到节点×时段粒度。
validation_protocols.baseline: TBD：现场人工计数双人复核建立基线；当前不声称已有实测准确率。
validation_protocols.threshold: TBD：缺测率、重复率和人工一致率阈值由专业团队与公众使用者共同确认；未达到前仅内部演示，不公开服务等级。
validation_protocols.error_stratification: 按节点、天气、时段、步行/骑行类别、活动/非活动日、设备状态和无障碍替代通道分群。
validation_protocols.human_reviewer: 数据治理负责人+人工计数员；每个窗口抽检并保留审计签名。
validation_protocols.failure_handling: 撤下看板数值，改显示“数据不足/TBD”，补做人工计数；不以插值掩盖缺测。
validation_protocols.stop_conditions: 无法证明匿名聚合、重复率不可控、人工复核缺失，或公众投诉连续上升时停止。

scenario_data_lifecycle.name: HuanYu AI wayfinding

scenario_data_lifecycle.delete_or_withdraw: withdraw by clearing optional preference; static/paper alternative
scenario_data_lifecycle.prohibited_uses: identity, face, exact trajectory, behavioral profiling
scenario_data_lifecycle.governance: anonymous aggregation only; key decisions human-reviewed; no over-surveillance

scenario_data_lifecycle.governance: anonymous aggregation only; key decisions human-reviewed; no over-surveillance

scenario_data_lifecycle.governance: anonymous aggregation only; key decisions human-reviewed; no over-surveillance

scenario_data_lifecycle.governance: anonymous aggregation only; key decisions human-reviewed; no over-surveillance

node_cards.name: 智造轮港 / Zhizao Cycle Port
node_cards.current_problem: Concept diagnosis: a potential interface between innovation work and the slow loop; actual entrance, ownership, conflicts and demand are unverified.
node_cards.suitable_space: Existing public-edge or shared-space interface, only after site survey and permission; no fixed parcel assumed.
node_cards.program_zones: quiet arrival / repair and rest / prototype display / human help desk / emergency clear zone
node_cards.slow_conflict_and_section: Potential conflict: bike test, walking, queue and service access. Concept section: walking edge | buffer | bidirectional cycling band | planted rain edge | clear emergency line; widths TBD after survey.
node_cards.component_placement: Reversible sign post, repair rack, shade/rest module, paper board and removable display rail; no permanent works implied.
node_cards.accessibility: Step-free route concept from public edge to help desk, tactile/contrast cue and rest interval; continuity and slope require professional field verification.
node_cards.operation: Concept lead: site operator; collaborators: developer community, university, community and safety reviewer.
node_cards.admission: Only after permission, safe clear path, steward roster and manual fallback are confirmed.
node_cards.stop_withdraw: Stop on blocked access, safety incident, unreviewable alert, complaints unresolved for two review cycles, or loss of permission; remove modules and restore site.
node_cards.data_dependency: Official boundary/ownership, pedestrian-cycling counts, conflict observations, accessibility survey, utilities and heritage constraints are TBD.

node_cards.name: 原点轮廊 / Origin Loop Gallery
node_cards.current_problem: Concept diagnosis: the railway-memory and daily-community link is not yet mapped to verified heritage objects or public access conditions.
node_cards.suitable_space: Existing open edge or community-facing display frontage; no heritage structure intervention assumed.
node_cards.program_zones: quiet heritage reading / bilingual timeline / human guide point / community forum / clear accessible passage
node_cards.slow_conflict_and_section: Potential conflict: stopping viewers, through cyclists and event queues. Concept section: heritage buffer | display edge | walking lane | low-speed crossing | cycling band; actual line and protection zone TBD.
node_cards.component_placement: Removable timeline frames, tactile/large-print panel, seating, low-glare marker and paper feedback box; no drilling or attachment to heritage fabric.
node_cards.accessibility: Step-free, rest seating, large-print and multilingual fallback concept; professional accessibility and heritage review required.
node_cards.operation: Concept lead: culture editor or appointed public-space operator; collaborators: residents, volunteers, universities and heritage professionals.
node_cards.admission: Only after heritage value/permission, clear route, content rights and human guide coverage are verified.
node_cards.stop_withdraw: Stop if heritage risk, crowd conflict, content-rights issue or access obstruction appears; withdraw displays without altering the base site.
node_cards.data_dependency: Verified heritage register, protection requirements, public access, pedestrian counts, content rights and community feedback are TBD.

node_cards.name: 回环市集 / Loop Market
node_cards.current_problem: Concept diagnosis: a possible cycling-service and everyday-consumption interface may compete with pedestrian, delivery and emergency movements.
node_cards.suitable_space: Existing public-facing frontage or temporary market edge; commercial tenancy and public-space permission are unverified.
node_cards.program_zones: slow arrival / shared service counter / local-market display / rest and family zone / emergency clear route
node_cards.slow_conflict_and_section: Potential conflict: shoppers, parked bikes, delivery and through movement. Concept section: building edge | service setback | walking clear path | cycle slow zone | removable market modules; widths and times TBD.
node_cards.component_placement: Removable racks, shade, drinking point, bilingual price/service board and queue marker; no permanent kiosk or utility load assumed.
node_cards.accessibility: Step-free public route, visible queue alternative, seating and paper service; professional route and fire-safety review required.
node_cards.operation: Concept lead: market/space operator; collaborators: merchants, residents, visitors, volunteers and safety reviewer.
node_cards.admission: Only after permissions, delivery window, clear emergency route, staffing and manual service alternative are confirmed.
node_cards.stop_withdraw: Stop on blocked emergency route, crowd conflict, unsafe cycling interaction, service failure or permission withdrawal; remove temporary components.
node_cards.data_dependency: Ownership/permission, pedestrian and delivery observations, fire-safety, utilities, accessibility and merchant participation are TBD.
